hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/usr/bin/env bash set -euo pipefail
aws sts assume-role --duration-seconds 3600 --role-arn arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl --role-session-name "s3-test" > assume-role-output.txt
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=`grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=`grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=`grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"`
aws s3 cp "${managed_inputs}" .
csvcut -c "Study Identifier","Data is ready to process","Data Processed","Subject Type(s)" Managed_Inputs.csv > inputs.csv
#cat Managed_Inputs.csv
IFS=',' if [[ ! -f inputs.csv ]]; then echo "inputs.csv not found!" >&2 exit 1 fi
while read stdy_id is_ready is_processed subject_type; do if [[ ${is_ready,,} == 'yes' ]] && [[ ${is_processed,,} == 'no' ]]; then if [[ ${subject_type,,} == 'human' ]]; then #execute the update dataset update subject type api call, with the make_meta flag set to false #which sets a facet for all concepts for the study to the Human facet curl --fail --no-progress-meter --request PUT --header 'Content-Type: text/plain' \ --data-urlencode "datasetRef=${datasetRef}" \ --data-urlencode "make_meta=false" \ --data-urlencode "subject_type=${subject_type}" \ "${api}/dataset/subject_type" || exit 255
else if [[ ${subject_type,,} == 'multi' ]]; then #execute the dataset subject type api call, with the make_meta flag set to false and the multi_subject flag set to true #which will iterate through the study and add each concept to the corresponding facet for its subject_type metadata flag #TODO - NOT IMPLEMENTED YET, PENDING RMIP SAMPLE else #execute the update dataset level update subject type api call, #which sets a facet and metadata element for all concepts for the study curl --fail --no-progress-meter --request PUT --header 'Content-Type: text/plain' \ --data-urlencode "datasetRef=${datasetRef}" \ --data-urlencode "make_meta=true" \ --data-urlencode "subject_type=${subject_type}" \ "${api}/dataset/subject_type" || exit 255
fi
fi done < inputs.csv
log "Uploading list of studies and subject types to API" curl --request PUT --fail \ --header 'Content-Type: text/plain' \ --data-binary @"inputs.csv" \ "${api}/dataset/csv"
